messages.text: just had a huge blowup with my wife... again. feels like i can't even speak without her rolling her eyes or walking away. like i'm invisible in my own house.

You deserve to have your concerns heard, but it’s also important to protect your own emotional well-being when she’s not ready to engage. In moments when she withdraws, focusing on self-care or seeking support outside the immediate conflict can help you feel less powerless. therapy? no way. that’s not gonna fix anything — she’s the one with the attitude problem, not me. i’m not the one hiding in another room like a victim.

It’s frustrating when you feel like the other person is causing the problem, especially if you don’t see yourself as contributing to it. Therapy isn’t about assigning blame—it can offer tools for both partners to communicate and understand each other better. Even if she’s unwilling, individual support could help you cope and respond in ways that reduce conflict. Would you be willing to consider ways you can strengthen your own resilience in this situation?
